units.source_text: 匂亲王在昼间仔细看看六女公子的容颜，觉得实甚美丽，对她的爱情越发深厚了。

en.t: During the day, Prince Niou looked closely at the Sixth Princess's face and found her truly beautiful, so his love for her grew still deeper.

units.source_text: 六女公子身材大小适度，体态窈窕无双，头面与垂发优美可爱，与常人迥不相同。

en.t: The Sixth Princess was of perfectly balanced height and build, with an incomparable graceful figure; her face and flowing hair were lovely and elegant, utterly unlike those of ordinary people.

units.source_text: 肤色之娇艳令人吃惊，相貌之高贵令人自惭。

en.t: The delicate radiance of her complexion was astonishing, and the nobility of her appearance made others feel humbled.

units.source_text: 总之，全身都无缺陷，“佳人”这两个字当之无愧。

en.t: In short, there was no flaw anywhere in her whole person, and she was fully worthy of the word beauty.

units.source_text: 芳龄大约二十一二，已经不是童年，故身体上毫无不发育之处，一切圆满，正像盛开的花朵。

en.t: She was about twenty-one or twenty-two, no longer a child, so nothing in her body remained undeveloped; everything was complete, just like a flower in full bloom.

units.source_text: 父亲悉心教养，关怀无微不至，故品性上亦毫无缺陷。

en.t: Her father had educated her with the greatest care and attended to her in every detail, so there was no flaw in her character either.

units.source_text: 难怪父母对她如此痴心。

en.t: No wonder her parents were so devoted to her.

units.source_text: 只是讲到温柔与娇媚，总要首先想起二条院那位二女公子。

en.t: Yet when it came to gentleness and charm, one could not help thinking first of the Second Princess at Nijo-in.

units.source_text: 六女公子在回答匂亲王问话时，虽然也很怕羞，但并不过分瑟缩，处处表示着多才多艺与聪明干练。

en.t: When the Sixth Princess answered Prince Niou's questions, she was certainly shy, but she did not shrink back excessively; in every way she showed talent, intelligence, and competence.

units.source_text: 她有优良的青年侍女三十人、女童六人，相貌都长得不坏。

en.t: She had thirty excellent young waiting women and six young girl attendants, all of whom were quite good-looking.

units.source_text: 她们的服装，因为一般的华丽已经看厌，所以另取一种全新的样式，其美观出人意外。

en.t: As for their clothing, because ordinary splendor had already become tiresome, they adopted an entirely new style, and its beauty was unexpectedly striking.

units.source_text: 六女公子的婚仪，比三条院云居雁夫人所生大女公子入宫当太子妃时更加隆重，或许是为了匂亲王的声望与容姿特别优越之故吧。

en.t: The Sixth Princess's wedding ceremony was even more splendid than when the eldest daughter born to Lady Kumoi no Kari of Sanjo-in entered the palace as crown princess, perhaps because Prince Niou's reputation and appearance were especially outstanding.
